findings.entity: framed photo on side table beside bedroom window
findings.description: At 06.00-06.50 the photo frame on the small side table left of the window shows a light, yellowish scene with indistinct figures/landscape. When the same table and frame come back into view at 07.25-07.75 (same position under the artwork, left of the same curtained window), the photo is a clearly different image of a seated person in dark/white clothing. Nobody touches the frame, so the image change has no visible cause.

This exact painting hangs on the hallway wall (00:01.50-00:04.25), which she walks past before entering the bedroom. Turning back inside the bedroom at 07.00-08.50, the identical painting, with the same image and dark frame, hangs on the bedroom wall left of the doorway. It now appears in a second place, or has moved, with no action shown.

findings.entity: framed artwork above bedroom side table
findings.description: Above the side table at 06.00-06.50 is a smaller, darker-framed picture with a small colorful inset. By 07.50 the art in the same spot, above the same table, is a larger light-wood-framed green/red abstract with a different layout. Nobody touches it, yet the object looks like a different picture.
